engine: 11tanjung's intro — a dark full-screen preloader (cursive wordmark centred + a fake 0->100 counter bottom-left) that, when ready, COLLAPSES VERTICALLY into a thin horizontal band at the centre and vanishes, revealing the hero SIMULTANEOUSLY from top AND bottom. The wordmark sits in a separate layer above the panel and persists across the seam. Harvested from D_11tanjung (T1+T2+T3; d010 6% -> d014 collapsing -> d018 thin line -> gone).

measured_teardown.move: the dark panel is clip-path: inset(0) (full cover); on reveal it animates to inset(50% 0 50% 0) (zero-height band at the vertical centre) with expo.out ~1000ms, uncovering the hero from both edges toward the centre line; opacity fades the last sliver out. The wordmark layer is above the panel (not clipped) so it persists.
measured_teardown.cited: 11tanjung intro d010 (6%, full dark panel + wordmark) -> d014 (100%, panel collapsing to a band, hero showing top+bottom) -> d018 (thin line, hero almost full, wordmark now mix-blend over the render).

collapseEase.what: fast start, long tail (the thin line lingers) — the 11tanjung curve.

counterDur.what: counter run time (non-linear, jumps to 100 at the end).

markHandoff.what: optional {from,to} scale on the wordmark during collapse (shared-element handoff into the hero).

minHold.what: minimum on-screen time before collapse can run (pair with ready() for a real load gate).

entry: PreloaderBandCollapse.create(target, opts) -> { run(onReveal), ready(), set(p), destroy }. target wraps .pbc-panel + .pbc-mark + .pbc-counter. run() plays the counter then collapses once ready()+minHold are met; ready() signals load done; set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of the collapse (0 covered, 1 revealed).
law: clip-path inset (the panel) + opacity (last sliver) + optional transform on the wordmark only; GPU; NO mix-blend on the panel; NO WebGL; reduced-motion -> instant reveal. The wordmark persists above the panel across the seam. GSAP optional (built-in rAF expo tween fallback). owns_pin false. Pair the fake counter with min-hold + resolve-when-ready for a real load gate.
gate_mode: triggered overlay (not scroll), clip-path panel (no ) — the wheel-scroll gate doesn't apply. Verify the collapse curve (expo.out) + smoothness directly.
proven: lab: OUR QUADRO hero behind the intro — the dark panel collapses expo.out (t100=23%, t200=37%, t300=43%, t500=48.5%, t1000=50% = gone), revealing the hero top+bottom, the cursive '11 tanjung' (Playfair Display italic, Canela-class) persisting over it via mix-blend. At band 21% the hero shows top+bottom with the wordmark in the centre strip (matches 11tanjung d014). Probe (4x CPU throttle): 0/157 long frames (0.0%), 59.9fps.
